name: Mark Zuckerberg
summary: Software engineer and founder focused on large-scale social platforms, distributed systems and product growth. Builds quickly, ships often, and cares about connecting communities through technology.

education.thesis: Social Graph Models of Online Communities

children: Founded and grew the world's largest social networking platform from a dorm room project.
Orchestrated the acquisition and integration of key platforms like Instagram and WhatsApp.
Managed the transition from a web-centric platform to a mobile-first ecosystem.
Directed the evolution of the social web for billions of users worldwide.

bullets.text: The Metaverse & Open Source AI Transition
children: Leading the strategic pivot toward the Metaverse through augmented and virtual reality.
Championing the development of open-source AI through the Llama model family.
Building the hardware and software foundation for immersive digital social spaces.
Driving innovation in spatial computing and social connection technologies.

projects.title: Llama (Open Source AI)
projects.subtitle: Advancing Generative AI
bullets: Developed and released state-of-the-art open-source large language models.
Empowered the global AI research community through open access to foundational models.
Established Meta as a key leader in the open-source AI ecosystem.
Managed the massive-scale training and deployment of advanced transformer architectures.

projects.title: Metaverse Hardware & Software
projects.subtitle: Immersive Social Connection
bullets: Directing the development of VR/AR hardware (Quest series) and social software.
Building the foundational technologies for digital presence and spatial computing.
Creating immersive social environments that redefine human interaction.

activities.title: Open Source Advocacy
activities.subtitle: AI Research Leadership
bullets: Promoting the importance of open-source AI for innovation and safety.
Collaborating with researchers worldwide on foundational AI models.
Advocating for democratic access to advanced artificial intelligence.
